notes.text: COMM courses at 2000 and above level as well as those labeled as # will be included in the calculation of Major GPA for honours classification.

Subject to approval by the Major Programmes concerned, students may opt out of the Double Major Programme and register for the 1st Major Programme only. The decision to opt out is irrevocable. Students who have opted out are required to complete and fulfill all graduation requirements by following the study scheme of the 1st Major Programme as a single major. Students should be aware that such decision may result in a delay in graduation because the requirements of the single major study scheme differ from those of the Double Major Programme.

Students are required to take PSYC2010. Journalism and Communication & Psychology Double Major Programme students who have taken any one of the equivalent statistics courses including DOTE2011, ECON2121, GRMD2102, LING3403, PHPC2015, SEEM2430, SOCI2004, SPED2600, STAT2001 and 2006, STAT2101 and 2102 are exempted from taking PSYC2010, and they are required to take another PSYC course listed under 3(b) Elective Courses (2000 or above level) to compensate for the units.

Students are required to take PSYC3430. Journalism and Communication & Psychology Double Major Programme students who have taken ENGE3610 or LING3202 will be exempted from taking PSYC3430, and they are required to take another PSYC course listed under 3(b) Elective Courses (2000 or above level) to compensate for the units.
Students who take 12 units from 3(a) Elective Courses are required to take at least 12 units from 3(b) Elective Courses.
Students who take 15 units from 3(a) Elective Courses are required to take at least 9 units from 3(b) Elective Courses.

parts.description: Students are required to complete a minimum of 56 units of courses as follows:

subsections.title: Students must choose at least one concentration and take five or six courses among the courses prescribed under respective concentration area as follows
one DOTE course at 3000 or above level, excluding the courses taken for fulfillment of requirement (i) or (ii)
15 units of FINA courses at 3000 or above level, with no more than three 1-unit FINA courses
3 units of DOTE/FINA/MGNT/MKTG courses at 2000 or above level; and
12 units of DOTE/FINA/MGNT/MKTG courses at 3000 or above level, excluding the courses taken for fulfillment of requirement (i), with no more than three 1-unit FINA courses

notes.text: ACCT/DOTE/FINA/IBBA/MGNT/MKTG courses at 2000 and above level (excluding ACCT2111, 2121, IBBA3040, MGNT2511 and 2512) will be included in the calculation of Major GPA for honours classification.
Double concentrations in Marketing and Big Data and Quantitative Marketing are not allowed.

DOTE2021 and the associated units can be used to satisfy concentration requirements of double concentrations within (a) to (c). MGNT3010 and the associated units can be used to satisfy concentration requirements of double concentrations within (e) and (f).
Courses taken for the concentration requirements of General Business Concentration cannot be counted towards the requirements of concentrations (a) to (h).
Students claiming Entrepreneurship Concentration are not allowed to declare Minor in Entrepreneurship and Innovation.
ACCT2151 and ACCT3151 are mutually exclusive. Students who would like to pursue a career in accounting profession are advised to take ACCT3151 instead of ACCT2151.
